title: Arson at Puharich's house

tellings.quote: Puharich's house burn burned in 1978. Um to this day, no one really knows who did it, but it was a proven, you know, arson job by the the fire department.

plain: In 1978 the house of a man named Puharich in Ossining, New York, burned down, and the fire department found it was deliberately set. A researcher named Greg Malatzi tells this without naming a source, adding that to this day nobody really knows who set the fire.
